description: Conformational-state-selection targets for RF3: each protein has two well-characterized experimental conformational states; 'crystallized_state' is the state that dominates the PDB.
references: Wayment-Steele et al., Nature 625:832-839 (2024) - AF-Cluster (KaiB-TV validation PDB 8UBH)
Dishman & Volkman, Science (2021) PMC8017559 - fold-switching review
Schafer et al., bioRxiv 617857 (2024) - AF2 fails on selecase metamorphic switch
Saldano et al., Bioinformatics 38:4959 (2022) - CoDNaS-Q conformational diversity
Monzon et al., Database baw038 (2016) - CoDNaS 2.0

state_b.label: fold-switched (fs)
state_b.citation: Chang et al. 2017 Science; alt 5JWO chB X-ray 1.80 A (complex w/ KaiA-CI)

construct.notes: WT full length. 5JYT is a fold-switch-stabilized variant (~6 subs vs WT incl. Y8A, N30A - approximate) missing residues 100-108; use WT 1-108 for RF3.

state_b.label: beta-barrel CTD
state_b.citation: Burmann et al. 2012 Cell; beta state also in cryo-EM 6C6S/6C6T

targets.name: Mad2 (MAD2A)

state_a.label: O-Mad2 (open)
state_a.citation: Luo et al. 2000 NSMB; construct UniProt 11-195 (N-terminal truncation)

construct.notes: Full length. 1DUJ is truncated (UniProt 11-195); use full 1-205 for RF3.

targets.notes: C state dominates PDB: 1GO4 2.05 A, 2VFX 1.95 A, many checkpoint complexes.

targets.name: XCL1 / lymphotactin

state_b.label: beta-sandwich
state_b.citation: Tuinstra et al. 2008 PNAS; X-ray support 2NYZ chD/E 2.60 A (M3 complex)

targets.notes: Both reference states are NMR; beta-sandwich has X-ray support in 2NYZ.

targets.name: Selecase (MJ1213)

state_b.label: oligomeric autoinhibited
state_b.citation: Lopez-Pelegrin et al. 2014 Angew. Chem.; I100F/H107F mutant (sequence-verified)

construct.notes: Concentration-dependent monomer<->oligomer switch; C-terminal helix refolds to strand and swaps. 4QHJ is the I100F/H107F mutant; exact oligomeric order (dimer vs tetramer) undetermined.

targets.notes: AF2 fails on this switch (Schafer 2024 bioRxiv 617857).

targets.name: GA88 / GB88 (designed)

state_a.label: GA88 3-alpha-helix
state_a.citation: He/Alexander/Bryan/Orban 2008 PNAS; design Alexander 2007 PNAS 104:11963; 56 aa

construct.notes: Two distinct sequences with 7 fold-determining substitutions - a designed fold-switch pair, NOT a single-sequence switch. GA88: TTYKLILNLKQAKEEAIKELVDAGIAEKYIKLIANAKTVEGVWTLKDEILTFTVTE.

targets.notes: No UniProt accession (designed). Use with the two-sequence caveat.

targets.name: beta2-adrenergic receptor (beta2AR)

state_a.label: inactive
state_a.citation: Rasmussen et al. 2007 Science; T4L (P00720) replaces ICL3, receptor ~1-230 + 264-365

state_b.label: active (Gs-bound)
state_b.citation: Rasmussen et al. 2011 Nature; receptor 29-365 + T4L; alt 3P0G 3.50 A (nanobody-stabilized active)

construct.notes: Native full length. Both PDB states are T4L/fusion constructs; use native 1-413 for RF3.

targets.dms_dataset: Jones et al., eLife 2020 (PMC7707821) - ~7,800/7,828 singles, CRE-reporter Gs signaling, 4 isoproterenol doses

targets.name: Abl1 kinase

state_a.label: DFG-in active
state_a.citation: Tokarski et al. 2006 Cancer Res.; +dasatinib; UniProt 229-500

state_b.label: DFG-out inactive
state_b.citation: Tokarski et al. 2007 Acta Cryst S; +imatinib; UniProt 228-500; alt 1IEP (mouse P00520) 2.10 A 229-515 (Schindler 2000 Science)

construct.notes: Human kinase domain. 1OPJ rejected (also imatinib-bound / DFG-out, not a DFG-in partner).

targets.dms_dataset: none comprehensive; clinical resistance catalogs + Lyczek 2021 (94 mutations, PMC8609647)

targets.name: EGFR kinase

state_b.label: alphaC-out inactive
state_b.citation: Stamos et al. 2004 Cancer Res.; +lapatinib; UniProt 695-1022

construct.notes: Kinase domain. 2GS6 is active + ATP-analog; 5C8M/5CAV are allosteric-site mutant structures (not used).

targets.dms_dataset: Hayes 2024 Nat Commun (s41467-024-45594-4) ~22,500 variants full-length PC9; + 2025 bioRxiv 646429 KD-DMS (L858R, BLU-945)

state_a.label: inward-facing
state_a.citation: Abramson et al. 2003 Science; C154G mutant (sequence-verified); WT alt 2V8N 3.60 A

state_b.label: outward-facing
state_b.citation: Dang/Kaback 2014 PNAS; G46W/G262W + sugar (sequence-verified; no PDBe SIFTS, RCSB maps to engineered B1XBJ1); alt 5GXB 3.30 A

construct.notes: Full length. Both reference states carry point mutations; WT outward alternative is limited.

targets.name: Ubiquitin

construct.notes: Single 76-aa unit (polyubiquitin PDB mapping 609-684). Bias note: C-tail 72-76 ordered in crystal, flexible in solution.

targets.dms_dataset: Roscoe 2013 JMB 425:1583-77 (PMC3615125, PMID 23376099) all point mutants, yeast growth; + Roscoe & Bolon 2014 JMB 426:2854
targets.notes: Cleanest crystal-vs-solution bias check at high resolution.

targets.name: GB1 (protein G B1 domain)

state_a.label: crystal
state_a.citation: Derrick & Wigley 1994 Biochem; auth 2-56; alts 1PGA 2.07 A, 2QMT 1.05 A (P19909 variant)

targets.dms_dataset: Olson et al. 2014 singles at 55 positions + pairwise, IgG-Fc binding ('GB1(55)', journal likely Curr. Biol. 24:2641 - approximate); + Wu 2016 4-site combinatorial

state_a.label: crystal (oxidized)
state_a.citation: Katti et al. 1990 JMB; UniProt 2-109 / auth 1-108

construct.notes: Both reference structures are the oxidized form, so redox state is matched and the comparison isolates crystal-vs-solution bias.
